|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 2) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is the current text. Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V5-L-tatooinelarsmoisturefarm_ai-2026-01-20-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V5-L-tatooinelarsmoisturefarm_ai-2024-02-25.png]], 25 February 2024) → [[File:V5-L-tatooinelarsmoisturefarm_ai-2026-01-20-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V5-L-tatooinelarsmoisturefarm_ai-2026-01-20.png]], 20 January 2026).
